title: Firms’ confidence, satisfaction and trust in the FCA rise
summary: The FCA and Practitioner Panel annual survey of regulated firms provides valuable insights into how firms think we’re performing. The latest survey shows 79% of firms are highly satisfied with their relationship with the FCA, up from 74% last year. The proportion of firms rating... Read More
content: A recent annual survey by the FCA and Practitioner Panel reveals a positive trend in how regulated firms view the organization. Results show that 79 percent of firms are highly satisfied with their relationship with the FCA, marking an increase from 74 percent the previous year. Overall, firms' confidence, satisfaction, and trust in the regulatory body have all seen notable improvements.
content_ta: FCA மற்றும் Practitioner Panel நடத்திய சமீபத்திய ஆண்டுச் சர்வே முடிவுகள், ஒழுங்குமுறை நிறுவனத்தின் மீது நிறுவனங்களின் நம்பிக்கை அதிகரித்துள்ளதைக் காட்டுகின்றன. FCA உடனான தங்களது உறவில் 79 சதவீத நிறுவனங்கள் மிகவும் திருப்தி அடைந்துள்ளதாகத் தெரிவிக்கின்றன. இது கடந்த ஆண்டு 74 சதவீதமாக இருந்தது. ஒட்டுமொத்தமாக, FCA மீதான நிறுவனங்களின் நம்பிக்கை மற்றும் திருப்தி ஆகியவையும் கணிசமாக உயர்ந்துள்ளன.

title: Jeeves Raises $110 Million Equity Round to Scale Its Stablecoin-Native Banking Platform for Global Enterprises Across 35 Countries
summary:
Jeeves, the stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises, today announced $110 million in equity funding and the launch of its proprietary stablecoin wallet with payouts to 190 countries.
The round was led by CoinFund, with participation from AllianceBernstein, Andreessen Horowitz, Coinbase Ventures, CRV, GIC, Global PayTech Ventures, ParaFi, Vista, Wintermute, Y Combinator and others.
Saving global enterprises time and money, Jeeves is the financial operating system for thousands of businesses in sectors such as technology, mobility, financial services, retail, and e-commerce, including industry leaders like BMW, H&M, Lululemon, Burger King, Kavak and XP. Over 80% of customers utilize multiple products, including corporate cards, accounts payable and treasury payments, spend management, and agentic workflows, positioning the company as the default stablecoin-native platform for financial operations among global businesses.
The raise comes as Jeeves surpasses $5 billion in annualized total platform volume across its card and payments products. Stablecoin is the fastest-growing part of that volume. Eight months ago, stablecoin-settled activity on Jeeves was effectively zero. It is now running at $1.5 billion annualized platform volume, driven by enterprises that use Jeeves to move money between markets where correspondent banking is slow or expensive.
Jeeves is expanding its stablecoin card offering from 25 to 35 countries, including Argentina, Costa Rica, the Dominican Republic, Guatemala, Panama, Peru, Paraguay and Uruguay. That expansion means Jeeves covers nearly every market in Central and South America. Combined with its existing coverage across North America, the United Kingdom, and Europe, Jeeves' stablecoin card and spend management platform now reaches 35 countries in total. As part of the announcement, Jeeves is opening an office in Madrid to expand its core stablecoin-native cards and payments offering globally.
"The enterprises that choose Jeeves are global by default, requiring corporate cards, accounts payable, treasury payments, and financial automation that span continents, and every one of them is tired of legacy infrastructure that wasn't built for that. We built Jeeves as a banking platform on stablecoin rails because that's the only way to give companies the same speed and cost structure moving money between São Paulo and Berlin that they get transacting within one country. That is what a stablecoin-native banking platform for global business actually looks like," said Dileep Thazhmon, Founder and CEO of Jeeves.
Alongside the raise, Jeeves is launching a proprietary stablecoin wallet with instant payouts to 190 countries, a global AI spend tracking solution, and an accounts receivable (AR) module. Together, they give companies a single system to move money, track spend, and get paid, without stitching together banks, spreadsheets and point solutions across every market they operate in.
"Stablecoins are fundamentally changing finance for enterprises, but thus far, very few companies have created robust stablecoin-based infrastructure ideally suited to enterprises. Jeeves has built a full enterprise stack that allows enterprises to run their day-to-day operations, corporate cards and invoice payments atop stablecoins, bringing speed, modern money capabilities and much lower costs to their customers. Jeeves has real distribution among companies already operating across Latin America, the United States and Europe, and that combination of technology and adoption is why we led this round." said David Pakman, Managing Partner and Head of Venture Investments at CoinFund.  
With this round, Jeeves moves from a payments tool used by finance teams to the banking infrastructure enterprises use to move money everywhere they do business.
NoYesFundraising News02 Oct, 2026
content: Jeeves, a stablecoin-native banking platform for global enterprises, has raised $110 million in an equity funding round led by CoinFund. The company also announced the launch of its proprietary stablecoin wallet with payouts to 190 countries, alongside the expansion of its stablecoin card offering to 35 countries. Jeeves has surpassed $5 billion in annualized total platform volume, driven significantly by stablecoin-settled activity.
content_ta: குளோபல் நிறுவனங்களுக்கான ஸ்டேபிள்காயின்-நேட்டிவ் வங்கி தளமான Jeeves, CoinFund தலைமையில் நடத்தப்பட்ட ஈக்விட்டி நிதி திரட்டல் சுற்றில் 110 மில்லியன் டாலர்களை ஈட்டியுள்ளது. 190 நாடுகளுக்குப் பணம் அனுப்பும் வசதியுடன் கூடிய சொந்த ஸ்டேபிள்காயின் வாலட்டை அறிமுகப்படுத்துவதாகவும், தனது கார்டு சேவையை 35 நாடுகளுக்கு விரிவுபடுத்துவதாகவும் நிறுவனம் அறிவித்துள்ளது. Jeeves நிறுவனத்தின் ஆண்டு மொத்த இயங்குதள வர்த்தகம் 5 பில்லியன் டாலர்களைத் தாண்டியுள்ளது.

title: America at a crossroads: Commissioner Peirce’s parting challenge
summary: It is incumbent upon us to continue Commissioner Peirce’s mission, writes Will Schwartz, policy associate at the Blockchain Association.
content: America stands at a critical crossroads regarding financial and regulatory policy following Commissioner Peirce's departure. Writing for the Blockchain Association, policy associate Will Schwartz argues that it is now essential for the industry and policymakers to continue her vital mission and address the challenges ahead.
content_ta: Commissioner Peirce-ගේ பதவி விலகலுக்குப் பிறகு, நிதி மற்றும் ஒழுங்குமுறை கொள்கை விவகாரங்களில் America ஒரு முக்கியமான கட்டத்தில் நிற்கிறது. Blockchain Association அமைப்பின் கொள்கை இணைப்பாளர் Will Schwartz எழுதியுள்ள கட்டுரையில், அவரது முக்கியப் பணியைத் தொடர்வதும் சவால்களை எதிர்கொள்வதும் அவசியமானது என்று வாதிட்டுள்ளார்.

title: ‘Euro stablecoin isn’t enough’: EU issuers make case for USD tokens
summary:
European issuers' push for USD tokens under MiCA could enhance EU oversight but may increase reliance on non-euro currencies in global trade.
The post European issuers argue for USD tokens to complement euro stablecoins appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: European stablecoin issuers are advocating for USD-pegged tokens alongside euro stablecoins under the new MiCA framework. While this move could improve regional regulatory oversight, experts warn it might also increase global reliance on non-euro currencies in international trade.
content_ta: புதிய MiCA கட்டமைப்பின் கீழ் ஐரோப்பிய stablecoin issuers-கள் euro stablecoins உடன் சேர்த்து USD-pegged tokens-களையும் கோரி வருகின்றனர். இந்த நடவடிக்கை பிராந்திய ஒழுங்குமுறை மேற்பார்வட்டை மேம்படுத்தக்கூடும் என்றாலும், சர்வதேச வர்த்தகத்தில் non-euro currency-களின் மீதான உலகளாவிய நம்பிக்கையை அதிகரிக்கக்கூடும் என்று நிபுணர்கள் எச்சரிக்கின்றனர்.

title: Furious debate about THORChain vs NEAR shows idealism has limits
summary: The furious debate over Bitget’s $387.7M of hacked funds comes down to whether ideals around “permissionless and decentralized” tech means never intervening — even if you could.
content: A furious debate regarding Bitget and hacked funds has sparked discussion about whether the ideals of decentralized technology should prevent intervention. The controversy highlights the ongoing tension between maintaining permissionless systems and taking action during major security incidents.
content_ta: Bitget மற்றும் ஹேக் செய்யப்பட்ட நிதி குறித்த கடுமையான விவாதம், பரவலாக்கப்பட்ட தொழில்நுட்பத்தின் லட்சியங்கள் தலையீட்டைத் தடுக்க வேண்டுமா என்ற கேள்தியை எழுப்பியுள்ளது. அனுமதி இல்லாத அமைப்புகளைப் பேணுவதற்கும் பெரிய பாதுகாப்புச் சம்பவங்களின்போது நடவடிக்கை எடுப்பதற்கும் இடையே உள்ள தொடர்ச்சியான பதற்றத்தை இந்த சர்ச்சை வெளிச்சம் போட்டுக் காட்டுகிறது.

title: Circle urges EU to revise stablecoin reserve rules in MiCA review
summary:
Circle's proposal could reshape EU stablecoin regulations, potentially enhancing financial stability and fostering cross-border innovation.
The post Circle urges EU to rethink stablecoin reserve rules in MiCA review appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Circle has called on the European Union to revise its stablecoin reserve rules as part of the MiCA regulatory review. The company's proposed changes aim to shape the future of digital asset regulations in the region, with a potential focus on improving financial stability and supporting cross-border innovation within the cryptocurrency sector.
content_ta: MiCA ஒழுங்குமுறை மதிப்பாய்வின் ஒரு பகுதியாக stablecoin கையிருப்பு விதிகளை மாற்றிமைக்குமாறு EU-யிடம் Circle கோரிக்கை விடுத்துள்ளது. இப்பகுதியில் டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து ஒழுங்குமுறைகளை வடிவமைப்பதை நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ள இந்நிறுவனத்தின் முன்மொழிவு, நிதி ஸ்திரத்தன்மையை மேம்படுத்தவும் எல்லை தாண்டிய புதுமைகளை வளர்க்கவும் உதவும் என்று எதிர்பார்க்கப்படுகிறது.

title: 'Uptober' Off With a Bang as Bitcoin Surges to $86K
summary: Cooler inflation and two dovish Fed speakers have shifted the odds toward a rate hold, with payrolls due and CPI landing on October 14.
content: Bitcoin surged to $86,000 as October trading kicked off strongly, driven by shifts in monetary policy expectations. Cooler inflation data and comments from two dovish Federal Reserve speakers have increased the likelihood of a rate hold. Market participants are now awaiting upcoming payroll data and the Consumer Price Index release scheduled for October 14.
content_ta: Bitcoin விலை $86,000 ஆக உயர்ந்தது. அக்டோபர் மாத வர்த்தகம் தொடங்கியுள்ள நிலையில், பணவீக்கம் குறைந்துள்ளது மற்றும் Federal Reserve-இன் இரண்டு பேச்சாளர்களின் கருத்துக்கள் வட்டி விகிதத்தில் மாற்றங்கள் ஏற்படுவதற்கான வாய்ப்புகளை அதிகரித்துள்ளன. சந்தை முதலீட்டாளர்கள் வேலைவாய்ப்பு தரவுகள் மற்றும் அக்டோபர் 14 அன்று வெளியாகவுள்ள CPI வெளியீட்டிற்காக காத்திருக்கின்றனர்.

title: Morning Minute: NEAR Intents Hacked for $3.8M - Was It A Bullish Hack?
summary: Hacks are never good, but a rapid response, user compensation and 1-hour bug fixing seems to top the spectrum of team reactions.
content: NEAR Intents recently suffered a hack resulting in a loss of $3.8 million. Although security breaches are always concerning, the team's rapid response, commitment to user compensation, and swift bug fix completed within one hour have been widely noted as a positive model for crisis management in the cryptocurrency sector.
content_ta: NEAR Intents இல் சமீபத்தில் ஏற்பட்ட ஹேக் தாக்குதலால் 3.8 மில்லியன் டாலர் இழப்பு ஏற்பட்டுள்ளது. பாதுகாப்பு மீறல்கள் எப்போதுமே கவலை அளிப்பதாக இருந்தாலும், குழுவின் விரைவான நடவடிக்கை, பயனுள்ள இழப்பீடு மற்றும் ஒரு மணி நேரத்திற்குள் சரிசெய்யப்பட்ட பக் திருத்தம் ஆகியவை கிரிப்டோகரன்சி துறையில் ஒரு சிறந்த நெருக்கடி மேலாண்மை மாதிரியாகக் கருதப்படுகின்றன.

title: Bitcoin nears highest level since January as $85,000 sell wall clears, US jobs data disappoints
summary: Bitcoin climbed back toward $87,000 on Friday as sellers cleared out around $85,000, according to Glassnode.
content: Bitcoin climbed back toward its highest level since January on Friday, moving near $87,000 as a major sell wall around $85,000 cleared out. According to Glassnode, the upward momentum was further supported by disappointing US jobs data, boosting market sentiment.
content_ta: வெள்ளிக்கிழமை அன்று Bitcoin விலை ஜனவகி மாதத்திற்குப் பிறகு அதன் உச்சத்தை நோக்கி உயர்ந்தது. $85,000 பகுதியில் இருந்த விற்பனைத் தடை நீங்கியதை அடுத்து, விலை $87,000 ஐ நெருங்கியது. Glassnode தகவலின்படி, அமெரிக்காவின் வேலைவாய்ப்பு தரவுகள் ஏமாற்றம் அளித்ததும் சந்தை வளர்ச்சிக்குக் காரணமாக அமைந்தது.

title: BitGo CEO says Clarity’s failure left capital markets exposed to risk potentially worse than Lehman
summary: BitGo CEO Mike Belshe warned that Clarity's failure left systemic risks arising from one firm holding exchange, brokerage, and custody functions.

title: BMO Joins Project Agorá to Advance Cross-Border Payments Through Tokenization
summary:
BMO today announced its participation in Project Agorá, the global public-private collaboration convened by the Bank for International Settlements (BIS) and the Institute of International Finance (IIF) to explore how tokenization and programmability could enhance wholesale cross-border payments. The collaboration includes eight central banks and more than 40 regulated global financial institutions.
BMO's participation builds on Project Agorá's progress to date, including successful real-value, multi-jurisdictional testing conducted in July 2026, and complements its work with Canadian banks on a secure Canadian-dollar tokenized deposit solution. Through Project Agorá, BMO is extending its involvement in tokenized deposit innovation to a global, multi-currency setting.
"Institutional clients increasingly need to move money securely across markets, currencies and time zones without being constrained by traditional operating hours," said Derek Vernon, Head, North American Treasury and Payment Solutions, BMO. "By joining Project Agorá, BMO is bringing its payments expertise and work in tokenized deposits to a global collaboration focused on building faster, more efficient and resilient cross-border payment infrastructure."
Alongside its technical work, Project Agorá is examining important regulatory and legal considerations, including how tokenized central bank reserves and commercial bank deposits can operate within existing requirements for settlement, anti-money laundering, countering the financing of terrorism, and data privacy.

title: Bloomberg Launches Stablecoin Dashboard on the Terminal Powered by Data from Allium
summary:
Bloomberg today launched a stablecoin dashboard on the Bloomberg Terminal powered by data from Allium, a leading blockchain data platform for enterprises. Available at RWAS <GO>, the dashboard gives market participants onchain stablecoin data alongside the fixed income, FX and money market tools they already use.
Stablecoins now account for more than $300 billion in circulating supply and have become core infrastructure connecting digital asset markets to traditional finance, from settlement and cross-border payments to demand for short-dated U.S. Treasuries. Until now, tracking that activity has meant working with a patchwork of blockchain explorers and analytics sites.
The dashboard covers every stablecoin with more than $100 million in circulating supply — collectively more than 98% of the market — along with select smaller and non-U.S.-dollar-pegged stablecoins.
Inside the Dashboard
The dashboard presents stablecoin data in the same interactive format Terminal users apply to traditional market data. The default view compares covered stablecoins side by side on supply, mints, burns, transfer volume and velocity, with current data updated hourly and historical series updated daily. Users can drill into individual stablecoins to see activity across different blockchain networks, switch the view to analyze activity by network, or filter assets by peg type, including fiat currencies, commodities and other stablecoins.
Expanding Bloomberg’s Onchain Data Offering
Bloomberg has supported institutional participation in digital asset markets for more than a decade. Bitcoin pricing has been available on the Terminal since 2014, and Bloomberg today provides spot pricing, reference data, identifiers and benchmarks for 50 institutionally relevant cryptocurrencies, applying the same rigorous approach used across traditional asset classes. Bloomberg’s Crypto Exposure Analytics also helps compliance teams identify direct and indirect crypto exposure across portfolios.
The collaboration with Allium marks a meaningful expansion of Bloomberg’s onchain data capabilities, bringing blockchain-native data into the Terminal and integrating it within the workflows institutional investors already use. It builds on Bloomberg’s digital asset strategy, including a recent collaboration with Kaiko to make Bloomberg Data License content available on the Canton Network. Together, these initiatives reflect Bloomberg’s approach to digital assets: providing the data, analytics and connectivity institutions need as tokenized markets become integrated with traditional finance.
“Stablecoins are becoming an increasingly important part of institutional digital asset markets, particularly as firms explore how cash and assets can move within tokenized financial infrastructure,” said Matthew Parkinson, Global Head of Digital Assets Product at Bloomberg. “Our focus is on giving clients the same rigor, transparency and integration they expect from Bloomberg across traditional markets. Bringing comprehensive onchain data into the Terminal is an important part of that, and we expect to continue expanding the data and analytics available to clients as these markets continue to develop.”
“Institutions want the same certainty in onchain data that they already have in traditional markets,” said Ethan Chan, Co-Founder and CEO of Allium. “We’re proud to provide the stablecoin data powering this new Bloomberg Terminal offering and help make onchain data part of the financial workflows institutions already use every day.”

title: WealthAI Launches AI Agents That Take Control of Client Onboarding and KYC in a Fraction of the Usual Time
summary:
WealthAi, the AI operating system for wealth managers and advisers, has launched a new suite of AI agents designed to oversee the client onboarding and KYC process end-to-end.
New functionality uses AI agents to coordinate everything from client data and document collection to ID verification, PEP and sanctions checks, KYC and account verification

Whereas some AI tools allow wealth managers and advisers to automate individual elements of onboarding with AI in siloes, WealthAi's AI agents coordinate the entire process across clients, advisers, compliance and operations teams and the different systems involved.
WealthAi's agents collect client information and documentation, identify missing information, generate forms and initiate identity verification, PEP and sanctions checks, KYC and account verification, only bringing in human review and approval where required.
Client onboarding remains one of the most manual and fragmented parts of wealth management, often creating a poor client experience at the very earliest stages of a new partnership.
As part of the new capability, WealthAi's agents can connect into the specialist identity verification and compliance services needed during onboarding. This allows the agents to coordinate the process end-to-end, initiating the relevant checks at the appropriate stages and bringing in human review where required.
Like all of WealthAi's functionality, WealthAi's onboarding and KYC tools are built specifically for wealth managers and financial advisers, taking into account the unique complexities of their client relationships. The functionality also operates across multiple jurisdictions to help wealth managers whose clients have financial interests in various regulatory systems.
Jason Nabi, CEO of WealthAi, said: "Onboarding is still absurdly manual in wealth management. Advisers and relationship managers can spend hours chasing information, moving between systems, filling in forms and coordinating with compliance before a new client is ready to go.
"The opportunity with agents isn’t simply to automate another KYC check. It’s to understand where a client is in the process, what’s missing and what needs to happen next – and then actually move that process forward.
"That’s the difference between automating a task and automating the process. We want the agents to take care of much of the admin and coordination, while bringing people in where their judgement or approval is actually needed."
WealthAi's onboarding and KYC agents connect directly into WealthAi's Client File and firms' existing internal systems, allowing information collected during onboarding to feed into the ongoing client record rather than having to be manually transferred or re-entered across different systems.
This launch follows a series of agentic functionality launches in WealthAi's OS so far this year, including WealthAi for Advisors and the Compliance Solution.

title: Altery Reports Shift from Hours to Minutes in Due Diligence with Explainable AI
summary:
Payments compliance team handles growing onboarding volumes while helping train explainable AI agents
Altery has shared faster due diligence investigations, fewer false positives and the ability to handle rising onboarding volumes without increasing its compliance team’s headcount, in a new video case study released by Vivox AI.
The video features Bisi Giwa, Group Fraud and Financial Crime Officer at Altery, and Tim Khamzin, Founder and CEO of Vivox AI. It explores how explainable AI is being used in day-to-day compliance work, with analysts retaining responsibility for reviewing outputs and making decisions.
Altery’s team faced significant manual work investigating complex corporate structures and consulting multiple sources. Giwa says some investigations could take between four and six hours, while onboarding requests were increasing and the team’s size remained unchanged.
“We’ve transitioned from hours to minutes and we spend far less time now digging for answers,” said Giwa.
According to Giwa, Vivox AI has helped turn complex ownership structures into clear, readable maps, giving analysts visibility of the end-to-end ownership framework. She also reports fewer false positives and more focused escalations, allowing the team to concentrate on the risks that matter to Altery.
Giwa explains that transparency and human judgement were central to the team, alongside governance and an audit trail.
“What we’ve been able to do is add the layer of human judgement on top of the output. It’s explainable and it’s traceable,” she said.
The case study also highlights the active role compliance analysts can play in shaping AI systems. In the video, Khamzin explains that Vivox AI was embedded into Altery’s existing workflow through an API, with access to corporate registry documents from 155 countries. Altery’s analysts contributed feedback and insights and participated in training the AI agents.
Their involvement illustrates how deploying AI in compliance can extend beyond automating tasks: practitioners bring their experience of real investigations to the development of the tools they use, while continuing to assess the outputs.
“AI is a support. It doesn’t replace human judgement,” Giwa added.

title: ConnexPay Brings Virtual Cards to Mobile Wallets, Expanding How Businesses Pay
summary:
ConnexPay, the unified payments platform that connects customer PayIns to supplier PayOuts, has expanded its virtual card capabilities to support mobile wallets, allowing eligible virtual cards to be securely provisioned directly to Apple Wallet and Google Wallet for tap-to-pay purchases, without requiring users to download a separate app.
Virtual cards and digital wallets are playing an increasingly significant role in how businesses and consumers make payments. Juniper Research forecasts that global virtual card transaction value will grow from $5.2 trillion in 2025 to $17.4 trillion by 2029, an increase of 235%. At the physical point of sale, digital wallets already account for 17% of U.S. transaction value, with adoption growing at nearly three times the rate of overall POS growth, according to Worldpay’s Global Payments Report 2026.
ConnexPay's new capability brings the speed, security and control of virtual cards to in-person payments. Businesses can issue a virtual card and make it available through the mobile wallet already on a recipient's device, allowing them to tap to pay at the point of sale without waiting for a physical card or downloading and managing another app.
“Virtual cards have traditionally given businesses tremendous control over how payments are made, but their use has largely been limited to online and remote transactions,” said Ben Peters, CEO of ConnexPay. “By enabling virtual cards for mobile wallets, we're extending that same control to in-person payments. A card that exists entirely in the digital world can now be used at the physical point of sale just like a physical card.”
The capability can support a broad range of time-sensitive, in-person payment scenarios, from helping travelers cover approved expenses during a disruption or pay at the hotel front desk to supporting corporate T&E and vendor payments at the point of sale. Across these use cases, businesses can extend virtual cards to in-person payments while maintaining control over how and where funds are spent.
ConnexPay has also expanded its issuing capabilities with Mastercard Physical Cards, giving businesses another option for payment scenarios where a physical card is preferred or required. Existing virtual card customers can add Physical Cards without replacing or rebuilding their current issuing programs, while maintaining the spend controls, configurable limits, merchant category restrictions, program management tools and rebate opportunities available through ConnexPay.
Together, these capabilities give businesses greater flexibility to issue the right payment credential for the way a payment needs to be made, whether through a traditional virtual card, tap-to-pay or a physical card.

content: ConnexPay has expanded its virtual card capabilities to support mobile wallets like Apple Wallet and Google Wallet, enabling businesses to make secure tap-to-pay purchases at physical points of sale. This innovation extends virtual card control to in-person payments for travel, corporate expenses, and vendor transactions. Additionally, ConnexPay introduced Mastercard Physical Cards to offer businesses greater flexibility in choosing payment methods.

title: Barclays Scales Claude to Upgrade Operations and Improve Client Experience
summary:
Barclays, the British universal bank, is expanding its strategic collaboration with Anthropic to integrate secure, enterprise-grade AI systems across its global operations.
Barclays is extending Claude across the bank to accelerate software development, modernize legacy systems, and improve operational efficiency. As part of this rollout, Barclays expects Claude Code adoption to reach 50% of its developer population by the end of 2026, rising to a majority of software engineers in 2027.
Barclays builds with Claude to better serve customers
Integrating AI across a large, complex, and highly regulated organization requires both capable technology and disciplined governance. Expanding its collaboration with Anthropic reflects a shared commitment to deploying AI responsibly, reliably, and in ways that deliver real outcomes, such as providing faster support for customers.
“The true measure of any technology is the impact it has on customers, clients, and colleagues, and the outcomes it enables,” said Anne Marie Darling, Group Co-Chief Operating Officer at Barclays. “Expanding the use of Claude across Barclays is about more than adopting AI. It is about transforming how work gets done: reimagining processes, enhancing customer and client experiences, and building a simpler, more efficient organization within a secure and well-governed environment. By reducing time spent on routine activities and streamlining decision-making, we can enable colleagues to focus their expertise where it matters most, solving more complex problems, accelerating innovation, and delivering better outcomes for our customers, clients, and business.”
“Software engineering and cyber security are both being reshaped by increasingly capable AI systems,” said Craig Bright, Group Co-Chief Operating Officer at Barclays. “We're moving towards AI as an increasingly agentic capability embedded within how we build, test, secure, and operate technology. At Barclays, we're using Claude to help modernize legacy platforms, improve software quality, and allow our technical experts to focus on the most complex challenges. The combination of skilled engineers, cyber specialists, and trusted AI capabilities has the potential to fundamentally improve how technology is developed and managed across large-scale enterprises.”
Claude powers knowledge assistance to speed up customer servicing
One example of the partnership already in action is Barclays’ Colleague Knowledge Assistant, which helps Barclays UK employees find information and answers more quickly when supporting their over 20 million UK retail customers.
The capability, which has been live since 2025, is powered by Claude through a retrieval-augmented generation architecture. More than 16,000 colleagues have adopted the assistant, and it has handled over one million searches.
The result is faster access to information and quicker support for customers.
Enhancing operational efficiency in Barclays’ Global Markets business
Within Barclays' Global Markets business, Claude models are helping streamline how client inquiries are processed and managed.

Key implementations include the Colleague Knowledge Assistant for retail customer support and streamlining client inquiry processing within the Global Markets business.

content_ta: Circle’s Arc platform-ல் Morphோ-ன் டெபாசிட்டுகள் வெறும் இரண்டு வாரங்களுக்கு சற்று மேலான காலத்தில் $500 மில்லியனைக் கடந்துள்ளன. இந்த விரைவான வளர்ச்சி ஸ்டேபிள்காயின் சுற்றுச்சூழல் அமைப்புகள் மீது நிறுவனங்களின் வலுவான நம்பிக்கையைக் காட்டுகிறது. இருப்பினும், பிட்காயின் பிணையத்தை அதிகளவில் நம்பியிருப்பது எதிர்காலத்தில் பணப்புழக்க சவால்களை ஏற்படுத்தக்கூடும் என்று நிபுணர்கள் குறிப்பிடுகின்றனர்.

title: Hyperliquid takes HYPE multichain with Solana, Base, and Unichain via Wormhole
summary:
The multichain expansion of HYPE via Wormhole could enhance liquidity and trading efficiency, but also introduces cross-chain dependency risks.
The post Hyperliquid takes HYPE multichain with Solana, Base, and Unichain via Wormhole appeared first on Crypto Briefing.
content: Hyperliquid is expanding its HYPE token to multiple blockchain networks, including Solana, Base, and Unichain. The integration is powered by Wormhole, a cross-chain protocol. This expansion aims to improve liquidity and trading efficiency across different platforms. However, analysts note that utilizing cross-chain bridges also introduces potential security and dependency risks for users.
content_ta: Hyperliquid தனது HYPE token-ஐ Solana, Base, மற்றும் Unichain உள்ளிட்ட பல்வேறு blockchain நெட்வொர்க்குகளுக்கு விரிவுபடுத்துகிறது. இந்த ஒருங்கிணைப்பு Wormhole என்ற cross-chain நெறிமுறை மூலம் இயக்கப்படுகிறது. இந்த விரிவாக்கம் பல்வேறு தளங்களில் liquidity மற்றும் வர்த்தக திறனை மேம்படுத்துவதை நோக்கமாகக் கொண்டுள்ளது. இருப்பினும், cross-chain bridge-களைப் பயன்படுத்துவது பயனர்களுக்கு சாத்தியமான பாதுகாப்பு மற்றும் சார்பு Risks-ஐ அறிமுகப்படுத்துகிறது என்று ஆய்வாளர்கள் குறிப்பிடுகின்றனர்.

title: Grayscale’s AI crypto sector gains 54% in September, lapping the broader market
summary:
The post Crypto AI Sector Surges 54% as Investors Chase Agent Economy appeared first on Coinpedia Fintech News
The crypto AI sector just had a month that’s hard to ignore. It gained 54% in September, more than double the broader crypto market’s 24% return, according to Grayscale’s latest sector update. That kind of outperformance naturally gets attention. But the sector is still tiny compared with the rest of crypto, sitting at roughly $15 …
content: Grayscale reported that the crypto AI sector surged 54% in September, significantly outpacing the broader crypto market's 24% return. Driven by investor interest in the agent economy, this strong performance highlights growing momentum in artificial intelligence within the digital asset space, though the sector remains a small portion of the overall market.
content_ta: செப்டம்பர் மாதத்தில் கிரிப்டோ AI துறை 54% வளர்ச்சி கண்டுள்ளதாக Grayscale தெரிவித்துள்ளது. இது ஒட்டுமொத்த கிரிப்டோ சந்தையின் 24% லாபத்தை விட மிக அதிகமாகும். ஏஜென்ட் எகானமி மீதான முதலீட்டாளர்களின் ஆர்வம் இந்த எழுச்சிக்கு முக்கிய காரணமாகும். டிஜிட்டல் சொத்து சந்தையில் AI துறையின் வேகம் அதிகரித்து வருவதை இது காட்டுகிறது, எனினும் இந்தத் துறை ஒட்டுமொத்த சந்தையுடன் ஒப்பிடும்போது சிறிய அளவிலேயே உள்ளது.

title: Ethereum Price Faces A Critical $0.040 ETH/BTC Test
summary:

The Ethereum price setup just got more interesting. ETH/BTC has reportedly broken its long-running downtrend, ending a period of relative weakness against Bitcoin that had stretched back to 2017. That doesn’t automatically mean the next leg is guaranteed. The chart still has a major hurdle at $0.040, and what happens there could decide whether this …
content: Ethereum faces a critical market test as the ETH/BTC trading pair approaches the significant 0.040 level. Analysts report that ETH/BTC has broken a long-running downtrend that began in 2017, signaling a potential shift in its relative strength against Bitcoin. However, market observers note that overcoming the major hurdle at 0.040 remains crucial to determine the next major price direction for Ethereum.
content_ta: ETH/BTC வர்த்தக ஜோடியானது முக்கியமான 0.040 என்ற நிலையை நெருங்குவதால் Ethereum ஒரு முக்கிய சந்தைச் சோதனையை எதிர்கொள்கிறது. 2017 முதல் தொடர்ந்த நீண்ட கால கீழ்நோக்கிய போக்கை ETH/BTC உடைத்துள்ளதாக ஆய்வாளர்கள் தெரிவிக்கின்றனர், இது Bitcoin-க்கு எதிரான அதன் பலத்தில் சாத்தியமான மாற்றத்தைக் குறிக்கிறது. இருப்பினும், 0.040 என்ற முக்கிய தடையைக் கடப்பது Ethereum-இன் அடுத்த விலை திசையைத் தீர்மானிக்க மிகவும் அவசியம் என்று சந்தை பார்வையாளர்கள் குறிப்பிடுகின்றனர்.

title: New Hampshire Bank ATM Loader Accused of Stealing $259,574, Spending the Loot on Cars, Luxury Cruise
summary:
An armored truck driver hired to load cash into ATMs has been accused of stealing $259,574 from the machines and spending the money on cars, a cruise and other purchases. Federal prosecutors say Christopher Skinner, 41, formerly of Milford, New Hampshire, worked alone at ATM locations across the state and removed cash bundles before servicing […]
The post New Hampshire Bank ATM Loader Accused of Stealing $259,574, Spending the Loot on Cars, Luxury Cruise appeared first on The Daily Hodl.
content: A former armored truck driver in New Hampshire has been charged with stealing $259,574 from bank ATMs. Federal prosecutors stated that Christopher Skinner, who was responsible for loading cash into the machines across the state, removed currency bundles and used the stolen funds to buy vehicles, go on a luxury cruise, and make other personal purchases.
content_ta: New Hampshire-ஐ சேர்ந்த முன்னாள் armored truck driver ஒருவர், bank ATM-களில் இருந்து $259,574 திருடியதாக குற்றம் சாட்டப்பட்டுள்ளார். மாநிலம் முழுவதும் உள்ள ATM-களில் பணத்தை நிரப்பும் பணியில் ஈடுபட்டிருந்த Christopher Skinner, பணக் கட்டிகளைத் திருடி, அந்தப் பணத்தைக் கொண்டு கார்கள் வாங்கியதுடன் luxury cruise-விற்கும் சென்றுள்ளதாக Federal prosecutors தெரிவித்துள்ளனர்.

title: Reg A+ Pioneer Mark Rockefeller on Family Governance, Regulatory Overreach and the Future of Financial Advisors
summary: Capital Ideas podcast guest reflects on pioneering veteran-focused Reg A+ lending, why the SEC’s investor-protection instincts outran Congress’s intent, and how his new venture, Century House, is trying to give financial advisors a bigger role in their clients’ lives. Mark Rockefeller has spent the... Read More
content: Capital Ideas podcast guest Mark Rockefeller discussed his pioneering work in veteran-focused Reg A+ lending and shared concerns that the SEC's investor-protection regulations have exceeded congressional intent. He also introduced his new venture, Century House, which aims to help financial advisors play a larger and more integrated role in the lives and governance of their clients.
content_ta: Capital Ideas போட்காஸ்ட் விருந்தினரான Mark Rockefeller, veteran-focused Reg A+ lending-ல் தனது முன்னோடிப் பணிகள் குறித்தும், SEC-ன் investor-protection விதிமுறைகள் காங்கிரஸ் நோக்கத்தை மீறிச் செயல்படுவது குறித்தும் பேசினார். மேலும், financial advisors தங்கள் clients-ன் வாழ்வில் பெரிய பங்காற்ற உதவும் வகையில் தனது புதிய venture-ஆன Century House-ஐ அறிமுகப்படுத்தினார்.

title: Warren, Van Hollen pressure OppFi to ditch bank deal
summary: Weeks after nonbank lender Enova scrapped its bid to buy Grasshopper Bank, two Senate Democrats are urging nonbank lender OppFi to abandon its own dealmaking efforts.
content: Two Senate Democrats are pressuring nonbank lender OppFi to abandon its proposed bank acquisition deal. The push comes just weeks after another nonbank lender, Enova, scrapped its own similar bid to buy Grasshopper Bank, reflecting heightened regulatory and political scrutiny on fintech and banking partnerships.
content_ta: இரண்டு செனட் ஜனநாயகக் கட்சி உறுப்பினர்கள், OppFi நிறுவனத்தை தனது வங்கி கையகப்படுத்தும் ஒப்பந்தத்தைக் கைவிடுமாறு அழுத்தம் கொடுத்து வருகின்றனர். Enova என்ற மற்றொரு நிறுவனம் Grasshopper Bank ஐ வாங்குவதற்கான தனது முயற்சியைக் கைவிட்ட சில வாரங்களுக்குப் பிறகு இந்த அழுத்தம் வந்துள்ளது.

title: Dive Deposits: BofA, Barclays show their populist side
summary: Bank of America is expanding its apprenticeship program at a time of year when it typically would raise the hourly wage for its lowest-paid staff. Meanwhile, Barclays conceded (partially) on its office-return mandate.
content: Bank of America is expanding its apprenticeship program instead of implementing its usual seasonal wage increases for low-paid staff. Meanwhile, Barclays has partially conceded on its strict office-return mandate. Both major financial institutions are displaying a more accommodating, populist approach to their workforce amid changing workplace expectations and economic pressures.
content_ta: Bank of America தனது குறைந்த ஊதியம் பெறும் ஊழியர்களுக்கான வழக்கமான பருவகால ஊதிய உயர்வுக்குப் பதிலாக, தனது தொழிற்பயிற்சி திட்டத்தை விரிவுபடுத்துகிறது. இதற்கிடையில், Barclays தனது அலுவலகத்திற்குத் திரும்பும் கட்டளையில் ஓரளவு சமரசம் செய்துள்ளது. மாறிவரும் வேலைவாய்ப்பு எதிர்பார்ப்புகள் மற்றும் பொருளாதார அழுத்தங்களுக்கு மத்தியில், இந்த இரண்டு முக்கிய நிதி நிறுவனங்களும் தங்கள் பணியாளர்களுக்கு ஆதரவான ஒரு மக்கள் ஆதரவு அணுகுமுறையைக் காட்டுகின்றன.

title: $4.2B crypto bank Anchorage Digital cuts 17% of workforce: Report
summary: The reported cuts come as Anchorage expands its institutional footprint, including stablecoin issuance and a $100 million investment from Tether.
content: Cryptocurrency bank Anchorage Digital has reportedly cut 17% of its workforce. The layoffs come as the firm works to expand its institutional footprint, a process that includes stablecoin issuance and a recent $100 million investment from Tether.
content_ta: க்ரிப்டோகரன்சி வங்கியான Anchorage Digital தனது பணியாளர்களில் 17 சதவீதத்தினரை வேலைநீக்கம் செய்துள்ளதாகத் தகவல்கள் வெளியாகியுள்ளன. stablecoin வெளியீடு மற்றும் Tether நிறுவனத்திடமிருந்து பெறப்பட்ட 100 மில்லியன் டாலர் முதலீடு உள்ளிட்ட நிறுவனத்தின் விரிவாக்கப் பணிகளுக்கு மத்தியில் இந்த நடவடிக்கை எடுக்கப்பட்டுள்ளது.

title: This AI Is Already Fooling People on Video Calls Into Thinking Its Human, Company Says
summary: Tavus says 26 of 54 people on a one-minute video call thought its new Griffin model was human. The results are the company's own, and the model isn't going to retail customers yet.
content: Artificial intelligence company Tavus claims its new video model, Griffin, successfully fooled over half of the participants on a one-minute video call into believing it was a human. According to the company's internal testing results, 26 out of 54 people were deceived. Tavus stated that the advanced model is not yet being released to retail customers.
content_ta: Tavus என்ற செயற்கை நுண்ணறிவு நிறுவனம், தனது புதிய Griffin வீடியோ மாடல் மூலம் ஒரு நிமிட வீடியோ காலில் பங்கேற்றவர்களில் பாதிக்கும் மேற்பட்டவர்களை அது ஒரு மனிதர்தான் என்று நம்ப வைத்ததாகக் கூறியுள்ளது. நிறுவனத்தின் உள் சோதனைகளின்படி, 54 பேரில் 26 பேர் ஏமாற்றப்பட்டுள்ளனர். இந்த மேம்பட்ட மாடல் இன்னும் சில்லறை வாடிக்கையாளர்களுக்கு வெளியிடப்படவில்லை என்று Tavus தெரிவித்துள்ளது.

title: Crypto hackers exploit third-party Aave tool to steal 114 ETH
summary:
A third-party lending adapter built on Aave was exploited to steal about 114 ETH, worth over $300,000, while the protocol itself remained unaffected. On Oct. 2, blockchain security firm SlowMist said the attacker compromised two Safe multisig wallets through a flaw in the FlashLoopAdapter used with Aave v3 positions. The exploit allowed the attacker to […]
The post Crypto hackers exploit third-party Aave tool to steal 114 ETH appeared first on CryptoSlate.
content: A third-party lending adapter on Aave was exploited to steal approximately 114 ETH, valued at over $300,000. Security firm SlowMist reported that attackers compromised two Safe multisig wallets via a flaw in the FlashLoopAdapter used alongside Aave v3 positions. Despite the theft, the main Aave protocol itself remained secure and unaffected by the security incident.
content_ta: Aave-ன் தரப்பு கடன் வழங்கும் அடாப்டர் ஒன்றில் ஏற்பட்ட குறைபாட்டைப் பயன்படுத்தி தோராயமாக 114 ETH திருடப்பட்டது, இதன் மதிப்பு 300,000 டாலருக்கும் அதிகமாகும். FlashLoopAdapter-ல் ஏற்பட்ட கோளாறு காரணமாக attackers இரண்டு Safe multisig wallets-ஐ சமரசம் செய்ததாக SlowMist பாதுகாப்பு நிறுவனம் தெரிவித்துள்ளது. இந்தத் திருட்டு நிகழ்ந்தாலும், முக்கிய Aave protocol பாதுகாப்பாகவே உள்ளது.

title: Bitcoin Crashes Below $84K as Crypto Liquidations Near $600M
summary: Why is bitcoin down so much today despite the positive macro news in the US?
content: Bitcoin dropped sharply below the $84,000 mark, leading to a wave of widespread crypto liquidations nearing $600 million across the market. The sudden market downturn surprised many investors, raising questions about why digital assets are declining despite recent positive macroeconomic developments reported in the United States.
content_ta: Bitcoin விலை திடீரென $84,000-க்கு கீழே சரிந்ததால், சந்தையில் சுமார் $600 மில்லியன் அளவுக்கு கிரிப்டோ லிக்விடேஷன் ஏற்பட்டது. அமெரிக்காவில் சாதகமான மேக்ரோ பொருளாதாரச் செய்திகள் வெளியான போதிலும் டிஜிட்டல் சொத்துக்களின் மதிப்பு ஏன் தொடர்ந்து சரிந்து வருகிறது என்ற கேள்வியை இந்த திடீர் வீழ்ச்சி எழுப்பியுள்ளது.

title: SEC Proposes Rules That Could Change How Funds Custody Crypto
summary: SEC Chairman Paul Atkins said that the proposed rule could "replace the grey of uncertainty created by custody rules crafted for a bygone era."
content: The SEC has proposed new rules aiming to update how investment funds custody cryptocurrency. SEC Chairman Paul Atkins stated that the updated regulations are designed to replace the uncertainty of older custody frameworks that were created for a different era, providing clearer guidelines for digital asset management in the financial sector.
content_ta: கிரிப்டோகரன்சி சொத்துக்களை ஃபண்டுகள் எவ்வாறு பாதுகாப்பது என்பதை மாற்றக்கூடிய புதிய விதிகளை SEC முன்மொழிந்துள்ளது. காலாவதியான பழைய விதிகளால் ஏற்பட்ட நிச்சயமற்ற தன்மையை இந்த புதிய விதிகள் மாற்றும் என்று SEC தலைவர் Paul Atkins தெரிவித்துள்ளார்.

title: How Man City’s Premier League Verdict Could Damage the UK Economy
summary:
UAE officials warn a harsh Man City penalty could cool UK investment, putting a £30 billion partnership in the spotlight.
